crossRefs.note: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest…
You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked…
Alexander, the coppersmith, did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds,
Yahweh said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for…
crossRefs.keyword: because they have defiled. Heb. for the defilings of

crossRefs.note: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near…
and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?
Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.
It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous…
“Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk…
You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.
Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother…

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.
